api_changes.detail: The Groq API reference says chat completions are POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions. The sample only changes the model field.

code_change.before:
from groq import Groq
client = Groq()
chat_completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    model="deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b",
)
code_change.after:
from groq import Groq
client = Groq()
chat_completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    model="openai/gpt-oss-120b",
)
